{{Quote|Rebels are known to congregate in Anchorhead, so I feel there is a good chance the information we seek could be there. They might be in an abandoned building or in the back room of a cantina. I really have no idea.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sabol]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Lt. Sabol"}}</ref>}}
The '''Anchorhead Tavern''' was a small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AT" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Anchorhead Tavern served as a front for the activities of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:AT" /> Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nitra Vendallan]] operated from the cantina after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="SWG:NV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Nitra Vendalla|Tatooine}}</ref> as well as a [[Recruitment Agent|Rebel recruitment agent]].<ref name="SWG:AT" /> In addition, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jarad Gastin]] looked for Rebel sympathizers at the entrance of the building.<ref name="SWG:GU9">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Game Update 9}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sabol]] dispatched an agent to infiltrate the cantina in order to steal documents containing information about the location of a high-ranking Rebel officer that the Empire wanted assassinated.<ref name="SWG:LS" />

Some time later, the [[entertainer]] [[Anetia Kah'ryn]] tasked a novice entertainer with performing in the Anchorhead Tavern and gathering information from the patron [[Borra Setas]] concerning criminal and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] activity in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:TEL">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=class|Entertainer|The Entertainer's Life|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Anchorhead Tavern appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
